trio.name: Trio

buildOptions.name: Nightscout Web App (Careportal)

loop.name: Loop
loop.summary: Supports direct APNS remote carbs, bolus, and overrides via LoopFollow or LoopCaregiver with 30-second OTP security.

buildOptions.name: LoopFollow (with Loop Direct APNS Remote Control)
buildOptions.purpose: Full-featured alarm dashboard + direct APNS Remote Carbs, Bolus, and Overrides with 30s OTP security and real-time confirmation (Loop v3.11.1+).

buildOptions.name: LoopCaregiver
buildOptions.purpose: Dedicated native iOS remote bolus, carb entry, and override controller for a Master Loop user.
buildOptions.installMethod: GitHub Browser Build (TestFlight) or Xcode ($99/yr Apple Dev)

buildOptions.name: xDrip4iOS (Shuggah) — View & Alarms Only
buildOptions.purpose: View-only follower for Nightscout or Dexcom Share with Apple Watch & CarPlay complications.
buildOptions.installMethod: TestFlight / Self-Build via Xcode or GitHub Actions

aaps.name: AAPS (AndroidAPS)

buildOptions.name: AAPS SMS Remote Commands (via iOS Messages)

buildOptions.name: Nightscout Web App (Careportal)

buildOptions.name: LoopFollow / xDrip4iOS — View & Alarms Only
buildOptions.purpose: Monitor AAPS Nightscout glucose, IOB, and customizable alarms on iOS (Note: LoopFollow v6.2+ does not send Careportal commands to AAPS).

buildOptions.name: xDrip+ Follower — View & Alarms Only

ios.name: iOS (iPhone)
ios.subtitle: Unlocks Loop & Trio
ios.costNote: Paid Apple Developer Program membership required for 365-day signing and NFC capabilities (free tier requires 7-day rebuilds).
ios.buildMethod: GitHub Actions (Browser Build -> TestFlight) or macOS with Xcode

loop.name: Loop
loop.summary: Carb-absorption and insulin-effect prediction curve algorithm with native iOS & Apple Watch app.

cgms.name: Dexcom G7 (10-Day & 15-Day) / Dexcom ONE+
cgms.driverTag: Native BLE Intercept • G7 / ONE+ App
cgms.extraNote: Provides a reliable 5-minute background BLE wake heartbeat.
cgms.howToUseWithAlgorithm: Pair your sensor in the official Dexcom G7 or ONE+ iOS app first, then open Loop -> Settings -> Add CGM -> Dexcom G7. Loop intercepts the Bluetooth packets directly offline.

cgms.name: Dexcom G6 / Dexcom ONE / Anubis Transmitter
cgms.extraNote: Anubis extended-life transmitters supported in Loop v3.14.6+.
cgms.howToUseWithAlgorithm: Enter your 6-digit Transmitter ID inside Loop -> Add CGM -> Dexcom G6. Runs 100% offline alongside the official Dexcom G6 app or xDrip4iOS.

cgms.name: FreeStyle Libre 3 / Libre 3 Plus
cgms.extraNote: Requires Loop `next-dev` branch for native direct BLE, or a custom xDrip4iOS fork.
cgms.howToUseWithAlgorithm: Build Loop `next-dev` for built-in direct Bluetooth pairing, OR pair with a custom `xDrip4iOS` (`libre3-integration`) build and select 'xDrip4iOS' via Shared App Group in Loop.

cgms.name: FreeStyle Libre 2 / 2+ (EU / International)
cgms.extraNote: Requires paid $99 Apple Developer account for iOS NFC entitlement. (US/CA Libre 2 is unsupported).
cgms.howToUseWithAlgorithm: In Loop -> Add CGM -> FreeStyle Libre, scan the sensor via iPhone NFC to start direct 1-minute Bluetooth streaming into Loop without needing the Abbott app.

cgms.name: Senseonics Eversense E3 / Eversense 365
cgms.extraNote: Do not run the official Eversense app simultaneously while Loop is connected.
cgms.howToUseWithAlgorithm: Select 'Eversense' inside Loop -> Add CGM to pair directly with the smart transmitter over Bluetooth.

cgms.name: Medtronic Guardian / Simplera (Remote Nightscout)
cgms.extraNote: Warning: Cloud-only CGM does NOT wake Loop in the background if iOS suspends the app.
cgms.howToUseWithAlgorithm: Requires a separate uploader device pushing readings to Nightscout, then select 'Nightscout' as CGM in Loop. Requires constant internet.

pumps.name: Insulet Omnipod DASH
pumps.driverInfo: Built-in OmniBLE driver — Direct Bluetooth from iPhone to pod (no PDM or bridge needed).

pumps.name: Insulet Omnipod 5
pumps.driverInfo: Native Omni5Kit BLE driver included in Loop v3.14+ (Direct Bluetooth to pod).

pumps.name: Medtrum TouchCare Nano (200U / 300U)
pumps.driverInfo: Native MedtrumKit Direct BLE driver (supports MD0201/8201 200U & MD8301 300U).

pumps.name: SOOIL Dana-i / Dana RS (v3)
pumps.driverInfo: Direct Bluetooth via DanaKit branch (or use Trio on iOS for built-in mainline support).

pumps.name: Insulet Omnipod Eros (Classic UST400)
pumps.deprecatedNote: Discontinued by Insulet. Still supported in Loop for remaining pod supplies using a 433 MHz RF bridge.
pumps.driverInfo: OmniKit RF driver — Requires a 433 MHz RileyLink, OrangeLink, or EmaLink bridge.

pumps.name: Medtronic MiniMed 515/715, 522/722, 523/723 (<=2.4A)
pumps.deprecatedNote: Out-of-warranty legacy pumps (2006–2012) with specific older firmware. Cannot be downgraded if firmware is newer.
pumps.driverInfo: MinimedKit RF driver — Requires 916 MHz (NA) or 868 MHz (WW) RileyLink/OrangeLink bridge.

pumps.name: Tandem Mobi / t:slim X2
pumps.driverInfo: Proprietary Tandem BLE encryption; no open-source dosing driver exists.

trio.name: Trio
trio.summary: Brings the OpenAPS oref1 algorithm (Super Micro Boluses, Dynamic ISF, UAM) to iOS with a modern Swift UI.

cgms.name: Dexcom G7 (10-Day & 15-Day) / Dexcom ONE+
cgms.extraNote: Provides a reliable 5-minute background BLE wake heartbeat (ideal for Omnipod 5).
cgms.howToUseWithAlgorithm: Start your sensor in the official Dexcom G7/ONE+ app, then choose 'Dexcom G7' in Trio -> Settings -> Devices -> CGM. Trio reads Bluetooth broadcasts locally.

cgms.name: Dexcom G6 / Dexcom ONE / Anubis Transmitter
cgms.driverTag: Native BLE or xDrip4iOS App Group
cgms.howToUseWithAlgorithm: Select 'Dexcom G5 / G6 / ONE' in Trio and enter your 6-digit Transmitter ID, or share values offline from a same-team build of xDrip4iOS.

cgms.name: FreeStyle Libre 3 / Libre 3 Plus
cgms.driverTag: Direct BLE (Trio Open Beta) or xDrip4iOS Fork
cgms.extraNote: Direct BLE supported natively in Trio Open Beta (`dev`) for all regional sensors.
cgms.howToUseWithAlgorithm: Pair directly via Bluetooth in Trio -> Devices -> CGM -> FreeStyle Libre 3 / 3 Plus, or bridge via custom `xDrip4iOS` Shared App Group.

cgms.name: Roche Accu-Chek SmartGuide (14-Day CGM)
cgms.howToUseWithAlgorithm: Select 'Accu-Chek SmartGuide' in Trio -> Devices -> CGM to connect via direct Bluetooth or run alongside the official SmartGuide app.

cgms.name: Medtronic Guardian / Simplera (Remote Nightscout)
cgms.extraNote: Does NOT provide a background BLE wake heartbeat.
cgms.howToUseWithAlgorithm: Pulls glucose from a Nightscout URL fed by an external uploader phone. Not compatible with pumps requiring a local BLE heartbeat.

pumps.driverInfo: Built-in mainline Dana(RS/-i) Direct Bluetooth driver.

pumps.name: Medtrum TouchCare Nano (200U / 300U)

aaps.name: AAPS (AndroidAPS)
aaps.summary: Comprehensive Android system featuring built-in safety objectives, SMBs, Dynamic ISF, and extensive Bluetooth pump support.

cgms.name: FreeStyle Libre 3 / Libre 3 Plus
cgms.driverTag: Trusted BG • Direct BLE via Juggluco
cgms.extraNote: Recognized as a Trusted BG Data Source in AAPS (unlocks unconditional SMBs offline).
cgms.howToUseWithAlgorithm: Install Juggluco on Android to connect directly to Libre 3 via Bluetooth, enable 'Patched Libre / xDrip broadcast' in Juggluco, and select 'Juggluco' or 'xDrip+' as BG Source in AAPS.

cgms.name: Dexcom G7 (10/15-Day) / G6 / ONE+ / ONE / Stelo
cgms.driverTag: Trusted BG • xDrip+ Direct / BYODA / Notification Reader
cgms.extraNote: Recognized as a Trusted BG Data Source in AAPS for full offline SMB operation.
cgms.howToUseWithAlgorithm: Use xDrip+ (Direct Native BLE), BYODA (G6/G7), Juggluco (G7/ONE+), or AAPS Notification Reader (G7/ONE+/Stelo).

cgms.name: FreeStyle Libre 2 / Libre 2 Plus
cgms.extraNote: Recognized as a Trusted BG Data Source in AAPS.
cgms.howToUseWithAlgorithm: Connect directly via Juggluco or xDrip+ (with OOP2 native Bluetooth decryption) and broadcast locally to AAPS every 1–5 minutes offline.

cgms.name: Syai X1 / Ottai M8
cgms.driverTag: Trusted BG • Native AAPS 4.0 / Notification Reader
cgms.extraNote: Recognized as a Trusted BG Data Source in AndroidAPS 4.0.
cgms.howToUseWithAlgorithm: Select the native Syai/Ottai BG source or Notification Reader in AAPS 4.0.

cgms.name: Eversense E3/365 / CareSens / PocTech / Companion Apps
cgms.driverTag: Non-Trusted BG • xDrip+ Companion / Eversense App
cgms.extraNote: Note: Classified as a non-trusted BG source in AAPS (standard temp basals work; 'SMB always' is restricted).
cgms.howToUseWithAlgorithm: Connect sensor via Eversense app / ESEL or xDrip+ Companion mode broadcasting locally to AAPS.
